description: This schema describes the data contained in beta-particle records in beta-decay datasets.  Note that the 'intensity' field from radiation.json applies to beta-minus intensity, or the combined beta-plus/electron-capture intensity, as determined by the dataset's decay mode.

energy.description: This is the endpoint energy of the decay.

averageEnergy.description: The average energy of the emitted beta particle.  This is always calculated during the evaluation, and measurements are not provided.

betaIntensity.description: The fraction of EC+B+ decay which goes through the beta branch.

electronCaptureIntensity.description: The fraction of EC+B+ decay which goes through the electron-capture branch.  The portions which go through individual electron shells are further broken out in the 'K', 'L', ... properties.

logft.description: The log(ft) value associated with this beta decay, typically used to constrain spin-parity values.

forbidden.description: Indicates that a transition is forbiden by the noted order: 1=first-forbidden, 1u=first-forbidden-unique, 2=second-forbidden, ...

spectralShape.description: An experimental beta-decay spectral shape.  This is currently supplied by external programs.
